body.name: anomaly_detection
body.description: Flags calls that don't resemble recent normal calls for this agent. Catches failure modes you didn't write a check for — no labels required.

fields.label: Anomaly threshold (0–1)
fields.helper: KNN mean cosine distance above which a call is flagged.

fields.label: Reference window (days)
fields.helper: Compare against calls ending in the last N days.

fields.label: Min neighbours before scoring
fields.helper: Below this, the detector returns insufficient_data instead of a number.

fields.label: KNN k
fields.helper: Number of nearest neighbours to average.

fields.label: Backfill per run
fields.helper: Embed this many un-embedded neighbour calls per run (0 = off).

body.name: factual_consistency
body.description: LLM judge: did the agent's responses stay grounded in the KB chunks the search returned, or did it hallucinate? Reads tool call trace events for search_knowledge_base invocations.

fields.label: Judge model
fields.helper: Only model available for evaluator judges.

body.name: flow_completion
body.description: Did the flow reach a terminal node (end or transfer) — or did the call drop out mid-flow? Free, flow-only.

body.name: intent_fulfillment
body.description: LLM judge: given the agent's instructions, did this call achieve the goal?

fields.label: Judge model
fields.helper: Uses the OpenAI eval-judge model. Other tiers are not enabled for evaluators.

fields.label: Sample rate (%)
fields.helper: 100 = every call. Lower for cost control.

body.name: kb_relevance
body.description: LLM judge: did the knowledge-base search return chunks that addressed the user's query? Reads tool call trace events for search_knowledge_base invocations.

fields.label: Judge model
fields.helper: Only model available for evaluator judges.

body.name: audio_silence
body.description: Listens to the recording (not the transcript) for unusually long silences — dead air, TTS stalls, mid-word hangups. Catches things text-only evaluators physically can't see.

fields.label: Max silence (ms)
fields.helper: Pass when no single silence exceeds this; default 5000ms (5s).

fields.label: Silence threshold (dB below avg)
fields.helper: How quiet a stretch must be to count as silent. -40 ≈ very quiet.

fields.label: Min silence run (ms)
fields.helper: Ignore silences shorter than this. Keeps natural conversational pauses out.

body.name: node_dead_end
body.description: For each node visited in the call, did the conversation transition out of it (good) or end there mid-flow (bad)? Free, flow-only. Lets the Issues page surface which specific nodes are dead-ending most often.

body.name: process_reward
body.description: Scores each turn as +1 progress / 0 neutral / -1 regression toward the agent's stated goal. Surfaces calls that "succeeded" but spent turns going backwards.

fields.label: Judge model
fields.helper: Only model available for evaluator judges.

body.name: stuck_loop_detector
body.description: Did the conversation keep returning to the same flow node instead of progressing? Flags 'agent is stuck in a loop at node X' patterns. Free, flow-only.

fields.label: Max visits per node before flagging as stuck

body.name: tool_call_correctness
body.description: LLM judge: were the agent's tool/function invocations the right choices given the conversation? Unlocked by tool-call tracing.

fields.label: Judge model
fields.helper: Only model available for evaluator judges.

body.name: transition_correctness
body.description: LLM judge: was each flow transition the right edge to take? Per-source-node attribution lets the Issues page surface which nodes have mis-firing transitions. Uses map-reduce per-transition judging with shuffled alternatives to fight position bias.

body.name: latency_slo
body.description: Flags turns where total latency exceeds the SLO threshold. Free heuristic, runs on every call.

fields.label: Threshold (ms)
fields.helper: Turns slower than this are flagged. Industry default: 3000ms.
